rows.text: makes the call at `00511660+0x09` with the incoming registers unchanged and returns its value when non-zero; otherwise reads a and then b with the calls at `00511660+0x1A` and `00511660+0x24` (each with `r9`) and returns `002D6640(b, a)`

notes: 00280120 and 00267E10 are not named on this page, so their calls are cited by site.
